location_name: Tiwi Carbon Study fire experiment, western Melville Island
description: Eucalypt open forest (mesic savanna) co-dominated by Eucalyptus tetrodonta, Eucalyptus miniata and Corymbia nesophila; C4 grass understorey and multi-stemmed woody resprouts.
fire treatments: annual early dry season burning; triennial early dry season burning; fire exclusion (unburnt)
locality: Imalu, Shark Bay, Taracumbi and Pikertaramoor, western Melville Island, Tiwi Islands
notes: Pooled across the four Tiwi Carbon Study locations (18 treatment sites); coordinates are the Tiwi Carbon Study centroid given in Freeman (2017) thesis Appendix S3.1, not in this paper. Natural savanna between Acacia mangium plantation blocks; fire treatments informally imposed from plantation establishment (2005/06), formal experiment from 2009.

description: Eucalypt open forest (mesic savanna) in natural vegetation between Acacia mangium plantation blocks.
notes: Rainfall from manual gauges 2005/06-2008/09 (Appendix S1). Fire metrics are 2009-2015 means of proportion burnt and fire intensity: plot 1 annual (87% burnt, 964 kW/m); plot 2 triennial (100%, 6744 kW/m); plot 3 unburnt. Coordinates not given (Figure 1 map only).
